entities.summary: Teresa Parodi (b. 1947-12-30, Corrientes Province) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Corrientes Province and Argentina. Known in the fields of argentina, composers & musicians, americas.
